title: AWS delays Lambda deprecated-runtime lockout to March 2027
summary: AWS pushed back the block-function-update deadline for Lambda's deprecated Python 3.9, Node.js 18.x, Node.js 20.x and Ruby 3.2 runtimes from the originally announced September 30, 2026 to March 3, 2027; new-function creation on these runtimes is blocked starting February 1, 2027.

title: CA/Browser Forum TLS certificate max validity drops to 100 days
summary: Under Ballot SC-081v3, the CA/Browser Forum's maximum public TLS certificate validity period reduces from 200 days to 100 days for all publicly trusted certificates.

sources.title: TLS Certificate Lifetimes Will Officially Reduce to 47 Days

title: TLS certificate rules tighten: 100-day validity and serverAuth-only EKU
summary: Two certificate-policy changes take effect the same day: CA/Browser Forum Ballot SC-081v3 cuts the maximum validity of publicly-trusted TLS certificates to 100 days, and Chrome Root Program Policy v1.8 requires newly issued public leaf certificates to carry the serverAuth EKU only, ending public-CA-issued TLS client authentication certificates.

sources.title: Ballot SC081v3: Introduce Schedule of Reducing Validity and Data Reuse Periods
Chrome Root Program Policy v1.8: What Changes in 2026

title: Amazon EKS Kubernetes 1.32 extended support ends
summary: Following AWS's standard policy of 14 months of standard support plus 12 months of extended support for each EKS minor version, Kubernetes 1.32 (GA'd January 23, 2025) exits extended support on Amazon EKS.

title: Amazon-FTC antitrust bench trial rescheduled to March 2027
summary: The FTC's monopolization bench trial against Amazon, before Judge John Chun in the Western District of Washington, has been pushed back again via an amended scheduling order to begin March 29, 2027.
location: U.S. District Court, Western District of Washington (Seattle)
